lines.t: When the night is deep and silent
And the heart feels worn and torn
Your whisper breaks the darkness
Calling the lost and the forlorn
You gather every broken soul
And bind their wounds with grace
Your mercy flows like rivers
A light we can't replace
Oh Lord, your love is endless
A fire that never fades
You reach through storms and shadows
And lift the hearts you make
Your truth is our foundation
Your hands are rest in place
Forever we will praise you for love that never fails
Your voice thunders through the heavens, yet gentle as the rain
You call us into freedom, you heal our deepest pain
The earth and all creation bow down before your throne
For every heart that calls you will never stand alone
You are the lamb, the lion The breath that calls us home
In your light we see forever We are yours, we are not our own
Oh Lord, your love is endless, a fire that never fades
You reach through storms and shadows and lift the hearts you've made
Your truth is our salvation, your name our living flame
Forever we will praise you, forever you remain
